title: What if your phone died at 1% with one urgent message left to send?

lines.text: One percent. You have one urgent message left, and the screen is already dimming.
caps: You have one urgent message left,
and the screen is already dimming.

lines.text: Outside, the neon streetlamp floods your glass until the screen goes white.
You slip into the dark hallway. The door creaks open at the corner.
caps: You slip into the dark hallway.

lines.text: You keep moving, thumb off the brightness you cannot spare.
A puddle throws the neon sign straight back into your face.
caps: A puddle throws the neon sign

lines.text: You snatch the phone up. The battery icon turns red.
The outlet is three steps ahead, past the charger on the floor.
caps: The outlet is three steps ahead,
past the charger on the floor.

lines.text: You dive. The screen dims to nothing while your hand is moving.
Plug. One percent comes back, and the message sends to yourself.
caps: and the message sends to yourself.
